title: Columbia River Gorge Waterfalls & Mt Hood Tour from Portland, OR
includes: Transportation in a premium, high-roofed passenger van
Gratuity (we recommend 20% for your guide, if you enjoyed the tour) (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A maximum of 12 people per booking
policies: Dress in layers as you travel though varied climates
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Follow the path of an ancient riverbed, carved by the last Ice Age, past the Bridge of the Gods, and explore the Windsurfing Capital of the World. In the afternoon, traverse Oregon’s fertile fruit valley on the way to the alpine top of a volcano, which boasts a title as the world’s 2nd most summited mountain in the world. Come along on this whirlwind journey to experience a selection of Oregon’s wonders.
